name: My Wife has a Master
source:
Samantha and her husband are trying to hold their marriage together, but cracks are already there. Stress, frustration,
emotional distance, and unspoken desires begin to pile up.
Then Lucian enters their lives. Calm. Elegant. Charismatic. Wrong in a way neither of them can explain.
What follows is not just seduction. It is corruption, obsession, and a supernatural descent that turns love into submission.
translation:
萨曼莎与丈夫正努力维系濒临破裂的婚姻，然而裂痕早已存在。压力、挫败感、情感上的疏离，以及难以启齿的欲望正越积越深。
就在这时，卢西安闯入了他们的生活。沉稳、优雅、魅力非凡，却透着一种夫妻二人都无法言喻的诡异感。
随之而来的远不止是引诱——而是一场堕落、执念与超自然的沉沦，将爱意一步步扭曲为臣服。
